latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of FlexClip Alternative — fast AI-powered promo video creation.

- Instantly generate 30-second promo videos with text overlays and background music; just upload your clips and describe your vision.
- Supports most common file types (MP4, MOV, JPG, PNG, etc.), up to 500MB per file.
- Handles all editing, rendering, and export automatically via a cloud GPU backend — no local software required.
- Session-based workflow with API token management, anonymous mode, and free credits available for new users.
- Simple commands for uploading, querying status, checking credits, and exporting final videos.
